name: Macaron
message: 「Well? Ready to behave and listen now?」

name: Arden
message: 「While I'm messing around here, I've gotta go chase after little Pasta!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, are you okay? Does anything hurt?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Really, are you really okay? Are you really alive?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm so glad you're safe, Big Brother...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, making us go through all that trouble.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Getting taken out by such a wimpy attack.」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you do something like that, it makes me feel responsible...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, I did it on my own, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're right, sorry for causing you trouble...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes ma'am, thank you so much for your help!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Still, I couldn't just leave you passed out like that, big bro.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is that supposed to be a thank-you? You don't have to do that!」

name: Macaron
message: 「We're even when it comes to helping each other out!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Honestly, big bro, you're such a handful!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's a miracle you've managed to live on your own like this.」

name: Macaron
message: 「At this rate, there's no telling when you'll end up in danger again!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I suppose there are all sorts of possibilities, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aah, I guess I have no choice!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Since I'm worried about you, big bro, I'll look after you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I said, I'm going to look after you, big bro!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's okay... if I live here, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then, as a special favor, I'll stick by you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, it'll keep out the cold better than sleeping outside, and it'll be easier to get to my part-time job from here too!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I have one less thing to worry about, my training will go smoother too!」

name: Synn
message: 「So you really were worried about me.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Shut up! That's just how I am!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It wouldn't feel good beating a hopeless big brother, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I need my rival to actually have his act together, don't I?」

name: Macaron
message: 「So with that said, I'll be in your care from now on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, it's my own place, after all.」
If Macaron is going to look out for me like this.
Then I want to do whatever I can for her too.
We're supposed to help each other out in times of need... though of course, that's not the only reason.
Having Macaron close by feels fun, or maybe calming, or maybe restless...
Either way, it just makes me want to spend even a little more time together.

name: Sally
message: 「Yep! Up in the attic right there!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, they're letting me live here starting today too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like things are gonna get lively.」
